diffs.diff: PM1.0 ug/m3: datasheet reading gives 1 per count, the part's model has none
diffs.evidence: The gate only scans sim.responses, but the model sim.uartReplies and driver use exactly the datasheet scale for this field; the Winsen ZPHS01B manual gives '(Byte2*256+Byte3) ug/m3= 101ug/m3' (scale 1, matching uartReplies pm1 scale 1 and driver _u16(f, 2)).
